# HarborIQ

> HarborIQ helps independent insurance agencies find carriers that might write a risk, with the carrier's own guideline attached to every answer. Three ways in: a **free agency workspace** ($0 per agency); **Intelligence**, everyday carrier research at $29 per agency per month or $290 per year; and **Agency OS**, the full agency system of record priced by agency size from $199 per month. Never priced per person. Canonical domain: https://harboriq.co

Key facts (as of October 2026):
- Free agency workspace, $0 per agency: private underwriter contacts and portal links, license and CE reminders for the dates the agency enters, limited carrier discovery with sources, a small private guide upload, optional team invitations, and an optional agency profile published only with the agency's approval.
- Intelligence, $29 per agency per month or $290 per year billed upfront: 300 carrier checks each month shared across the whole agency, the agency's own carrier guidance searchable, answers with sources and dates the user can inspect, carrier appetite comparison, and basic book insights from exports the agency provides. One carrier check is one carrier question and its source-backed answer. Optional $10 packs add 100 checks, only when the agency chooses; there are no automatic top-ups. Works alongside any AMS and replaces nothing.
- Agency OS, priced by agency size with identical features at every price: $199/month solo, $399 for 2 to 5 people, $599 for 6 to 15, $899 for 16 to 25, $1,199 for 26 to 35, $1,499 for 36 to 50. Above 50, custom. Client records, policies, documents, pipeline, renewals, commissions, reports, team roles, and carrier Ask. Annual is 11 months' price with the book import included; on monthly, the import is a one-time fee equal to one month. Intelligence allowances and packs do not apply to Agency OS.
- Month to month, cancel anytime, data always exportable. No per-person fees.
- Agency OS replaces the common agency stack of an AMS (EZLynx, HawkSoft, Applied Epic, NowCerts) plus a CRM overlay (AgencyZoom or GoHighLevel). The free workspace and Intelligence run alongside whatever the agency uses today.

- [Agency OS](https://harboriq.co/agency): the full agency system of record, including pipeline CRM, renewals, appetite-first quoting with coverage-gap comparison (automated rating is roadmap), and team performance
